result.note: Tested the closing approvals and Gujarat concentration of ISM 1.0; the merged Supreme Court item was left aside as this is a single Also in the news slot.

questions.prompt: In May 2026, the Union Cabinet approved the final two projects under India Semiconductor Mission (ISM) 1.0. Consider the following statements:
items: The two projects are a Gallium Nitride (GaN) display panel facility in Dholera and a chip packaging plant in Surat.
The two projects together bring in investment of about INR 39,360 crore.
Half of the projects approved under ISM 1.0 are located in Gujarat.
questions.ask: How many of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 2 is wrong: the two assembly-tier facilities bring a combined INR 3,936 crore (USD 414 million). With these approvals ISM 1.0 closes at 12 projects worth INR 1.64 lakh crore, six of them in Gujarat.
questions.source: The two assembly-tier facilities bring a combined INR 3,936 crore (USD 414 million) in investment and close out ISM 1.0 at 12 approved projects worth INR 1.64 lakh crore (USD 17.3 billion).
